velvet-wine.$description: Velvet Wine — Page canvas and deepest section background — the floor everything sits on

burgundy-stage.$description: Burgundy Stage — Section and card surfaces, slightly lifted from the canvas to separate bands of content

impossible-red.$description: Impossible Red — Primary action buttons, active toggles, headline accents, icon emphasis — the single chromatic signal that commands attention

blush-highlight.$description: Blush Highlight — Soft secondary text, pill toggles in default state, link hover, tonal counterpoint to the aggressive red

butcher-black.$description: Butcher Black — Top navigation background, hairline borders, card outlines, deep contrast strokes

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Navigation and button text, body copy on dark surfaces, inverted toggle text

sans-meat.$description: The only typeface on the site. Carries everything from 10px micro-labels to 231px hero statements. Weight 700 dominates display and CTAs; 400 and 500 handle body, nav, and secondary UI. The display sizes are anti-convention — most brands cap hero text around 64–80px; sans-meat's display reaches viewport-filling proportions because the brand is built on the stunt of oversized declarations like 'STEAK (FROM PLANTS)' and 'THE POTLUCK'.
